definitions.explanation: Something done by sheer physical strength, or by extension a forceful approach that gets results without finesse.

examples.japanese: {力技|ちからわざ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}する→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧。
examples.english: To solve it by brute force.

examples.japanese: ⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦{扉|とびら}→扉：04494_tobira⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{力技|ちからわざ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦こじ{開|あ}けた→こじ開ける：33180_kojiakeru⟧。
examples.english: I forced the heavy door open by sheer strength.

examples.japanese: ⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{省|はぶ}いて→省く：02398_habuku⟧、{力技|ちからわざ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}し{通|とお}した→押し通す：20718_oshitoosu⟧。
examples.english: They skipped the fine-tuning and pushed the plan through by force.

notes:
Often slightly critical in the figurative sense, though it can also praise an impressive effort (⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な{力技|ちからわざ}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {力技|ちからわざ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{押|お}し{切|き}る→押し切る：06793_oshikiru⟧: to force one's way through
- {力技|ちからわざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to resort to force

WRITING:
Also written {力業|ちからわざ}.
